design.one_flow: Every entry-file operation follows one pattern. Decide and take splitDNSRepair.queue() in the owner turn, then platformWork.run in that same turn. Inside the block, run the operation and Observation.after (the residue read) in one resolvers.serialized scope, against the operation's own config. Then record on the owner with await recordSplitDNS(observation, source:, startedAt: place). Gate-driven work (VPN transitions and the two post-write corrections) goes through the single host helper reconcileEntryFiles(config:runtimeStarted:).

sites_moved_off_owner.handleVPNStateChange: gate update, decision and enqueue in one turn. The proxy-repair delivery is requested before the await (it queues in a later turn regardless). The orchestrator VPN handling runs after the entry files land (files-before-orchestrator kept, as directed).

design.removed: the inline refreshInterceptFiles(for:platform:) helper. Replaced by interceptRefresh(for:platform:), which captures the bindings in the deciding turn and returns the @Sendable work; used by the flag refresh, the settle refresh and the config-change block.
design.freshness: Stamps are per operation and monotonic in queue order, not a count of recorded outcomes. So an earlier-queued success recording first never discards a later-queued failure, such as a refused VPN-down removal (review risk 1). Out-of-order completion (possible after an actor retag) drops only an outcome queued before one already recorded. The 'newer=' detail of platform.split_dns_outcome_superseded now means the gap in queue places; its wording in docs/events.md is parent-owned.
design.residue_semantics_change: The residue is now read against the operation's own config, inside its lock, where it used to be the host's accepted view at record time. They differ only for reapply (pass.new) and teardown (heldRuntimeConfig) while a newer view is adopted.
design.quiescence_and_cleanup: Nothing new is needed. VPN and retry work are deliveries (settle drains them). Lifecycle tails are inside their lanes. Reapply and flag actions are inside runEffect/runFlagEffect. A Stop's clears queue behind everything decided before its runtimeStarted = false.
